title: TypeSpec assessment: specification/securityinsights/resource-manager/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/SecurityInsights

items.title: Revise generated C# Security Insights model property names and resource identifier types
items.summary: The change updates C#-specific client customizations in client.tsp: four resource ID properties use ResourceIdentifier and six existing model properties receive replacement C# names. It does not change REST operations or the wire contract.

inferenceResults.rationale: The added C# @@alternateType decorators change four generated model-property types and can break existing source assignments.
The C# @@clientName changes rename one existing property and newly rename another generated property.
Two existing C# generated property names are explicitly replaced.
The added C# @@clientName changes the generated property name for an existing model property.
The added C# @@clientName changes the generated property name for an existing model property.
